protocol: Suited hypobaric chamber exposure followed by T-38 flight about 12 h later. Table III lists 65,000 ft in the first altitude column and 35,000 ft in the cabin-altitude column. Decompression altitude and prebreathe are unavailable.
outcome_window: Initial symptoms more than one hour after ground return; symptoms also reported at altitude in the subsequent flight.
note: One referred person, supported by four reviewers. The timing and altitude descriptions preserve the source columns. The paper gives no unselected chamber denominator.
